name: Augment Code Standard

price.note: Flat price, no per-seat charge, up to 50 seats.

meters.label: Included usage
meters.hint: $20 a month. app.augmentcode.com shows what's left.

reset.rule: Resets at the start of each billing cycle.
stipulations: Model tokens cost the provider's API list price plus a 40% service fee. That leaves about $14.29 of model use in $20.
Compute costs $0.19 an hour in 5-minute steps, with no fee.
Models, the Context Engine and compute all draw from one balance, shared by everyone on the plan.
Haiku 5.5 costs 5x above 100K tokens. GPT-5.6 and GPT-6 double input above 272K.
Prorated if you start mid-cycle. Unused usage doesn't carry over.

overage: After the included $20, usage keeps billing automatically at the same rates. The docs describe no cap and no off switch. Top-ups outside your plan last 12 months.

how: $20 of usage a month, charged at API list price plus 40% on models.
One balance covers models, the Context Engine and compute for the whole team.
ext: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, GLM and DeepSeek models.
Works in VS Code, JetBrains, Auggie CLI and Cosmos. The docs don't mention bring-your-own-key.
quirks: Harness bought Cosmos, Auggie CLI and the Context Engine on 8 Oct 2026. Augment hasn't said what this means for plans or the IDE extensions.
The Indie, Developer and Max plans are gone from the pricing page.
Standard cost $60 before 2 Nov 2026 (third-party report, unconfirmed).
card.alert: Overage bills automatically with no cap.

events.what: Gemini 3.7 Flash leaves the model pickers.
